beforeImage.name: Velocity FBO Network
beforeImage.description: Velocity FBO Network is Tallvine's U.S. fixed-base-operator platform, assembled from Odyssey Aviation's U.S. assets and expanded through add-on acquisitions. The network provides aircraft fueling, hangar, ground-handling and related business-aviation services across multiple U.S. airports. In February 2026, Velocity acquired BTR Jet Center after Baton Rouge approved assignment of the operating and hangar leases to Velocity BTR Holdings, LLC; the location now operates as Velocity Baton Rouge (KBTR). BTR Air Charter remains outside the platform perimeter because no evidence established that it was acquired.

afterImage.name: Velocity FBO Network
afterImage.description: Velocity FBO Network is Tallvine's U.S. fixed-base-operator platform, assembled from Odyssey Aviation's U.S. assets and expanded through add-on acquisitions. The network provides aircraft fueling, hangar, ground-handling and related business-aviation services across multiple U.S. airports. Velocity completed the acquisition of Havasu Air Center's KHII FBO assets and associated airport leaseholds on October 1, 2025 through Velocity Havasu Holdings, LLC; the location now operates as Velocity Lake Havasu, while aircraft management and Northstar Aviation Services remained outside the acquired perimeter. In February 2026, Velocity also acquired BTR Jet Center after Baton Rouge approved assignment of the operating and hangar leases to Velocity BTR Holdings, LLC; that location operates as Velocity Baton Rouge (KBTR), while BTR Air Charter remains outside the platform perimeter.

Odyssey Aviation North America rebranded as Velocity FBO Network under Tallvine ownership.
The Havasu sellers retained aircraft-management activities and Northstar Aviation Services maintenance operations outside the transferred FBO assets.
Havasu Air Center's KHII FBO assets began operating within the Tallvine-backed network as Velocity Lake Havasu.
Velocity identified Lake Havasu as its fourth operating location after the FBO asset acquisition.
